notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/devstral-small-1-1-25-07). It is a product/model catalog page (date, context, license, params, features), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables on this page. Text was taken from the page HTML/RSC (curl + Next.js RSC payload); headless Chrome dump-dom hung/failed in this environment. Weights table: Parameters (B) 24, Active (B) 24, Context Size 128k, License Apache 2.0. Modalities from tooltip labels: Text input, Text output (no image). Header date July 10, 2025 used as releaseDate (same pattern as sibling Mistral docs cards; page does not say the words 'release date'). The Blog link points to https://mistral.ai/news/devstral-2507 (SWE-Bench Verified 53.6% for Devstral Small 1.1, etc.); that blog is not in this card's seed documents, so those eval numbers were not included. Legal link goes to https://legal.mistral.ai/ai-governance/models/devstral-small-1 (lifecycle table); not extracted as a separate source. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup (single document).
